cd /app && python3 -c "
import angr,logging,struct,json
logging.disable(logging.CRITICAL)
p=angr.Project('a.out',auto_load_libs=False)
mem=p.loader.main_object.memory
out={}
for rel,backer in mem.backers():
    b=bytes(backer)
    base=0x400000+rel
    for i in range(0,len(b)-3,4):
        out[base+i]=struct.unpack('<I',b[i:i+4])[0]
json.dump(out,open('truth.json','w'))
print('count',len(out))
ks=sorted(out)
print('first',ks[0],out[ks[0]],'last',ks[-1])
" 2>&1 | grep -v -E 'WARNING|ERROR'

cd /app && node extract.js /app/a.out > out.json && python3 -c "
import json
a=json.load(open('out.json'))
t=json.load(open('truth.json'))
print('out',len(a),'truth',len(t))
ak={int(k):v for k,v in a.items()}
tk={int(k):v for k,v in t.items()}
match=sum(1 for k in tk if k in ak and ak[k]==tk[k])
print('matching truth keys',match, 'pct', round(100*match/len(tk),2))
wrong=[k for k in ak if k in tk and ak[k]!=tk[k]]
extra=[k for k in ak if k not in tk]
print('wrong',len(wrong),'extra_not_in_truth',len(extra))
# type check
print('int values?', all(isinstance(v,int) for v in a.values()))
"
